description: This file defines the CurlMultiHandler class, which manages asynchronous HTTP requests using PHP's curl_multi_* functions. It handles the creation, execution, and cancellation of multi cURL handles with options for delays and custom configurations, facilitating non-blocking HTTP request workflows.

classes.name: CurlMultiHandler
classes.description: Handles concurrent HTTP requests asynchronously using curl_multi functions, providing methods for executing, managing, and cancelling requests, with support for delayed handle addition and custom options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of CurlMultiHandler with optional configuration for handle factory, select timeout, and additional curl options.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the curl multi handle resource, setting options as configured.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Cleans up the curl multi handle resource during object destruction.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Begins an asynchronous request by creating an EasyHandle via the factory, returning a Promise that resolves upon completion.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Performs one iteration of the curl multi event loop, processing delays, running the select, and handling completed messages.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Runs the event loop until all requests have completed.

methods.name: addRequest
methods.description: Adds a request handle to the multi handle, scheduling immediate or delayed execution.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing request handle by removing it from the multi handle and closing it.

methods.name: processMessages
methods.description: Processes completed messages from curl, resolving associated promises and cleaning up handles.

methods.name: timeToNext
methods.description: Calculates the time until the next scheduled delay to skip or wait efficiently.
